description: The effective advanced settings: each value, the fields an environment variable sets, and when a change takes effect

config_beautifier.description: Format the generated nginx configs (env DISABLE_NGINX_BEAUTIFIER, inverted)

gravatar.description: Fetch Gravatar profile pictures, sends a hash of the email address to Gravatar (env DISABLE_GRAVATAR, inverted)

time_zone.description: Time zone of the container, one of time_zones (env TZ); applies after a container restart

locked.description: Fields that cannot be changed because an environment variable sets them, or forces them (see locked_by and locked_reason). A save ignores them (read only)

locked_by.description: For each locked field, the environment variable that sets it. A field locked by its own variable names that variable; a field another setting forces names the variable of that setting (read only)

config_beautifier.description: Name of the variable that locks the config beautifier: DISABLE_NGINX_BEAUTIFIER

gravatar.description: Name of the variable that locks the gravatar: DISABLE_GRAVATAR

time_zone.description: Name of the variable that locks the time zone: TZ

locked_reason.description: Always empty: no field of this section is locked by the variable of another setting

applies.description: When a change of each field takes effect

config_beautifier.description: When a change of the config beautifier takes effect: on save

gravatar.description: When a change of the gravatar takes effect: on save

time_zone.description: When a change of the time zone takes effect: after a container restart

restart_pending.description: Settings that apply after a container restart (applies restart) saved with another value than the container runs with: restart the container to apply them

time_zones.description: The time zones the image ships (/usr/share/zoneinfo without posix/ and right/), the values time_zone accepts
